_source: Output of harness/lumber_opt.plan_from_store run READ-ONLY (sqlite mode=ro, world=None i.e. no live character, route_check=False, seed=1, now=2026-10-05 ~20:26 local) over the full store. 132 spots (3 seeds + 129 lumber_spots rows: 125 active discover candidates promoted, 4 disabled). P(best) per spot from 2000 Thompson draws. rate_logs_h = posterior mean field rate (Gamma, quasi-Poisson dispersion phi, recency half-life 14 d, skill-rescaled to now); rate_80 = 80% interval; net_logs_h = renewal-reward net stored logs/h at Q*; deaths/sent_home/thefts per field hour are Gamma posteriors shrunk to pooled rates. Unvisited spots all share the empirical-Bayes prior (2316 logs/h, CV 0.4). Pick at this snapshot: witcher_219 (explore, P(best)=0.006); greedy best witcher_23.
